label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group interventional study where all enrolled ALS patients receive the video-based exercise program, with no placebo comparator described. The record describes only one experimental arm and says patients will be followed up by applying the exercise program before/after measures.

evidence.quote: Subsequently, the patients will be followed up
All patients will be asked to perform these exercises.

title: Video-Based Proprioceptive Exercise Program in ALS

rule.label: No placebo
rule.reason: All recorded arms have recognized non-placebo types and no placebo mention in arms/interventions. Inferred from saved data; sham controls count as no placebo.
